if len(spectra) > 0:
    last_spec = spectra[-1]
    # Save the result to satisfy the requirement of using save_result inside run_analysis
    save_result("mean_spectrum.csv", last_spec['intensity'], raman_shift=last_spec['raman_shift_cm-1'])
    print(f"Successfully saved mean spectrum from {last_spec['title']} as mean_spectrum.csv")

        print(f"raman_shift_cm-1 not found, trying wavelength_nm")

    if x_axis is not None:
        save_result("mean_spectrum.csv", spec['intensity'], raman_shift=x_axis)
        print("Success")

        print("Could not find a valid x-axis for the spectrum.")
else:
